requirement: A store's new WhatsApp number reaches its listings
expected: After the store changes its number, the WhatsApp button of every unsold store listing opens the new number; sold listings keep theirs.
preconditions: Verified store with approved and sold listings
steps: Change the store's WhatsApp in Mi tienda; open an approved listing and the sold one; inspect the wa.me links.

requirement: WhatsApp links open for numbers stored without +51
expected: A listing whose number is stored as 9 digits opens wa.me/51…; numbers already with 51 are unchanged.
preconditions: Listing whose number is stored as 9 digits
steps: Open the listing and press Contactar por WhatsApp.

requirement: A sold listing's similar link never lands on nothing
expected: On a sold listing with no similar public listings, Ver publicaciones similares scrolls to a line linking the catalog.
preconditions: Sold listing of a type with no other public listings
steps: Open it and press Ver publicaciones similares.
